title: Browser Check Result v2
description: JSON contract returned by the browser-checker agent to its caller (build-runner, debug). v2 adds visual evidence: per-capture Baseline/Candidate PNG pairs, diff ratio, diff heatmap, and optional visual verdicts. Step results replace the v1 assertions field. The version field is the v1/v2 discriminator.

version.description: Schema version. Always '2'. v1 files (no version field) remain valid under resources/browser-check-result.md but are not validated by this schema.

status.description: Overall outcome. 'pass': all step_results passed and no blocking visual regressions. 'fail': one or more step_results failed or a desktop regression verdict was reached. 'skipped': Playwright not available or server unreachable.

url.description: Full URL that was checked (base_url + first goto path).

captures.description: One entry per capture step executed in the spec, per viewport. If the spec has two viewports and one capture step, there are two entries. Absent for skipped runs.

name.description: Capture name from the check spec's capture step. Matches visual-verdict capture_ref.

viewport.description: Viewport name from the check spec (e.g. 'desktop', 'mobile'). Matches visual-verdict viewport.

baseline_png.description: Absolute path to the Baseline PNG (merge-base render). Null when no baseline was available (first run for this spec/SHA pair or cache miss).

candidate_png.description: Absolute path to the Candidate PNG (feature branch render). Null only on skipped runs.

diff_ratio.description: Fraction of pixels that differ between Baseline and Candidate (0.0 = identical, 1.0 = completely different). Null when either PNG is absent. Signal only — never a pass/fail gate.

diff_heatmap.description: Absolute path to the diff heatmap PNG (pixels highlighted by change magnitude). Null when baseline_png or candidate_png is absent.

visual_verdict.description: Vision-model judgment for this capture. Null when the zero-diff shortcut applied (diff_ratio under noise threshold and expected_visual_change is 'none'), when baseline_png is absent, or when the check was skipped.

step_results.description: One entry per executed step (all step types: goto, click, fill, waitFor, capture, expect). Replaces v1 assertions[]. A failed expect step sets status to 'fail' and always blocks the task.

description.description: Human-readable description of the step (e.g. 'goto /dashboard', 'click "Open settings"', 'expect role=dialog visible').

passed.description: Whether this step completed without error.

detail.description: Failure detail, DOM/screenshot excerpt, or locator that could not be found. Omitted (null) on pass.

console_errors.description: console.error and unhandled rejection messages captured during the run. Empty array if none.

artifacts_dir.description: Absolute path to the run directory (docs/browser-checks/YYYYMMDD-HHMM-<slug>/) containing all PNGs and the manifest JSON. Null on clean pass with no kept evidence (expected with expected_visual_change 'none'). Non-null when any capture is kept (intentional change, unexpected, uncertain, regression) or on fail/skipped.

skipped_reason.description: Human-readable reason when status is 'skipped'. Null otherwise.

visual_verdict.rationale: Nav bar collapses on desktop. Sidebar overlaps main content.
